race.comment: LE TROISIR (3) handy staying type in career best form. Had to circle the field again with a game second over this track and trip. Meets a few of these better at the weights with J Mac aboard from the good gate. Makes plenty of appeal. FOIRE DE TRONE (6) improving stayer who loves the rain affected going. Was a month between runs when she outclassed her rivals in the small field over this trip at Sandown-Hillside on the heavy (10) surface. Senior rider goes on and she looks up to this. I PARK (2) built on a nice third two starts back at Canterbury with success over 2400m at this track on the improving surface. Can handle the weight increase and give a good account again. MICHELANGELO (12) strips fitter and desperate to get out to this trip. Drifted back early and never appeared comfortable on the Canterbury track with a plugging fourth over 1900m. Will appreciate the sting out with just the 53kg. Can surprise. GOLDEN CENTURY (4) blinkers go on and assess on the good run two back.
